newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $93.8 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $93.8 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 5.161 billion shillings of treasury bills at its weekly auction, bank officials said on Friday.
In the main 91-day category of T-bills, the bank sold 4.801 billion shillings at an average weighted yield of 21.447 percent, against 5.711 billion shillings at 21.202 percent last week.
In the 28-day category the bank sold 359.75 million shillings at an average yield of 16.440 percent, against 315.95 million shillings at 16.505 percent last week.
There were no bids for 182-day treasury bills.
The central bank invited tenders for nine billion shillings of treasury bills for next weeks auction on Thursday.
